Package library

Class LibraryManager

java.lang.Object
library.LibraryManager
public class LibraryManager extends Object
Holds the list of books and performs all library operations: add, view, search, find, update, delete, change status and count books by status.

Books are stored in an ArrayList in memory. (The graphical interface saves them to a file and loads them again when the program starts.) Invalid operations throw an IllegalArgumentException with a message that can be shown to the user.

Author:
Narmeen Fatima, Faique Mustafa, Usaid Rauf

    • searchBooks

      public ArrayList<Book> searchBooks(String query, BookStatus statusFilter)
      Searches the books. A book matches when the search text appears in its ID, title, author, category or borrower (letter case is ignored) and, if a status is given, the book has that status. An empty search text matches every book.
      Parameters:
      query - the text to search for (may be null or empty)
      statusFilter - only books with this status are returned (null means any status)
      Returns:
      a new list of the matching books in the order they were added

    • searchBooks

      public ArrayList<Book> searchBooks(String query, BookStatus statusFilter, String memberId)
      Searches the books like searchBooks(String, BookStatus), and can also keep only the books that one member has issued or reserved.
      Parameters:
      query - the text to search for (may be null or empty)
      statusFilter - only books with this status are returned (null means any status)
      memberId - only books held by this member are returned (null means all books)
      Returns:
      a new list of the matching books in the order they were added

      public void updateBook(String currentId, String newId, String newTitle, String newAuthor, String newCategory)
      Updates the ID, title, author and category of an existing book.

      public void deleteBook(String id)

    • setStatus

      public void setStatus(String id, BookStatus newStatus, String borrower, String borrowerId, int loanDays)
      Sets the status (Available, Issued or Reserved) of the book with the given ID. Setting a book to Available clears its borrower and due date. Issuing a book records the borrower and a due date (today plus the loan period). Reserving a book records the person it is reserved for. A member cannot hold more than MAX_BOOKS_PER_MEMBER books.
      Parameters:
      id - the ID of the book
      newStatus - the new status
      borrower - the borrower name (needed for Issued and Reserved, ignored for Available)
      borrowerId - the borrower ID or registration number (may be empty)
      loanDays - the loan period in days (needed for Issued, between 1 and 60)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the ID is empty, no book has that ID, the status is null, the borrower name is empty (Issued or Reserved), the loan period is not between 1 and 60 days (Issued), or the member already holds the maximum number of books
